listing.name: Drakengard — Drakengard_Recomp (boubou666)
listing.summary: Experimental Drakengard source project. Upstream reports title/menu screens and a New Game path, but explicitly says it is not playable. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SLES52322 disc files and ELF. The ELF must have SHA-1 3b06fe9b7dfd378a55f481135e273aaaf39604be.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream instructions to generate code with Ghidra, recompile and build locally. These instructions are for Drakengard; the PlayStation 3 game Drakengard 3 is a separate project.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, logos, title/menu screens and a New Game path. The project explicitly says it is not playable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
